free_parameter: a_shock -- the split of the price family between 'my own bill rose' and 'someone else is cheaper'. No domestic instrument separates them; Ofgem's Consumer Impacts survey codes both as one answer.
level: every point of the sweep is re-anchored onto the published GB domestic switching record, so the interval is over the reason mix alone and not over the level as well.
basis: EXPECTED shares, hazard-weighted over every renewal in the captured run. NOT the realised mix.

population.svt_unreadable_reason: no SVT segment-decision file beside this table (c2_departure_factors_svt_segment_decisions.json). Either the capture predates C1b's `_svt_decisions` recorder or it was run against a tree without it.
population.warning: this reading CANNOT SEE the SVT inertia route (C1b). It is the renewal-decision population only, which is no longer the whole book, and the cause it cannot see is the one `departure_risks` calls the single largest departure route in a real domestic book.

causes_not_observable_reason: This mix is a decomposition of the RENEWAL hazard, taken over renewal decisions. C1b added a second departure route -- an account drifting off the standard variable product at a segment boundary -- which strikes no rate and reaches no renewal roll, so no row in this population can carry it. Its share here is UNKNOWN, not zero. On the two-route capture of 2026-08-31 it was 50 of 82 departures.
